+            if not isinstance(retries, Retry):
+                # When Retry is initialized, raise_on_redirect is based
+                # on a redirect boolean value.

+                retries.raise_on_redirect = raise_on_redirect
+                connection_pool_kw = connection_pool_kw.copy()
